about.title: Meet
paragraphs: I design and deliver B2B marketing automation and SaaS systems focused on chatbots, UGC content automation pipelines, and voice agents. I build GoHighLevel (GHL) solutions that include lead qualification, appointment booking, UTM tracking, funnels, and conversational workflows to drive acquisition and conversion.

My implementations connect CRMs, n8n automations, Supabase backends, and AI services to create production-ready pipelines for chatbots, voice-enabled agents, and UGC workflows—reducing manual work, improving lead flow, and increasing customer engagement and retention.
